clips.title: The story
paras: Collin Mauren is a human mage residing in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. A scholarly researcher and crafter of incantations, he experiments with exotic natural reagents to devise unique utility spells. Among his pursuits is assisting his acquaintance, the gnome engineer and explorer Gaxim Rustfizzle, with specialized arcane scrolls.

Situated within Stormwind's bustling Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren spends his days pursuing the quieter, more practical applications of magic. Rather than chasing raw elemental power, he focuses on crafting arcane formulas that solve specific, logistical problems. Collin often turns to natural anomalies and raw components scavenged across Azeroth, weaving their intrinsic properties into functional magic scrolls and reagents for friends and travelers alike.

Collin maintains a close friendship with the gnomish tinker Gaxim Rustfizzle. When Gaxim needed a way to set off his NG-5 explosives from a distance, Collin worked out that a messaging spell would do the job. To impress the spell onto a scroll, he uses debris from Westfall's erratic Dust Devils, and he looks forward to hearing how his inventive friend's scheme turns out.

Beyond his work with local elementals, Collin's research extends clear across the Great Sea to the crags of Kalimdor. Curiously captivated by the resilient hides of basilisks native to the Stonetalon Mountains, Collin seeks out their scales to synthesize new spells. Travelers venturing into Kalimdor frequently receive his requests for these rare hides, fueling Collin's ongoing fascination with how primal creature anatomy can stabilize complex enchantments.
